methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: AI Ready Roanoke evaluates use for new technology in Roanoke Valley - Roanoke Times
signals.signal_reading: A grassroots regional initiative to evaluate AI adoption signals emerging distributed capability building outside traditional tech hubs, potentially establishing peer learning networks that could spread deep AI fluency beyond NoVA.

signals.title: VCU partners with the Better Business Bureau to bring AI support to Central Virginia businesses - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU-BBB partnership delivering AI support to Central Virginia businesses suggests platform-mediated, service-layer adoption that creates broad but shallow capability rather than indigenous technical depth.

signals.title: Norfolk Public Library to teach people about AI - AOL.com
signals.signal_reading: Public library AI education programs represent crucial distributed access points for community-level skill building, potentially seeding peer networks in military-adjacent regions often overlooked in tech capacity discussions.

signals.title: Warner, Anthropic launch AI pilot to help Hampton Roads military families find local resources - The Legacy Newspaper
signals.signal_reading: Senator Warner partnering with elite AI firm Anthropic for military family services demonstrates concentrated expertise deployment where federal-defense nexus exists, but risks creating service dependency rather than local capability.

signals.title: Amazon bows to local backlash over AI data centers, scraps plans to build four new facilities in Northern Virginia — site to be repurposed for mixed-use and residential development. - Tom's Hardware
signals.signal_reading: Amazon canceling data centers due to local backlash reveals infrastructure concentration without community adoption or capability building—physical presence of AI industry failing to translate into distributed fluency or acceptance.
